description: Claude Code hook launcher exit-code semantics.

semantics.0: Hook completed; Claude Code may proceed (default fail-open when SURE is missing).
semantics.non_zero: SURE returned a non-zero status; Claude Code should treat this as a signal to review or block the action when the hook has decision authority.

note: The launcher itself never fabricates evidence. When the SURE binary is missing it exits 0 so the agent is not blocked by a missing local tool.
